span.normalized: In November 2025, we signed two separate power purchase agreements (PPAs) in Germany with Nordsee One GmbH and Solarkraftwerk Halenbeck-Rohlsdorf I/II GmbH to secure a significant proportion of the renewable electricity needed to power the REFHYNE II facility. The electrolyser is scheduled to begin operating in 2027.
